senses.gloss: स्फ्य॑ n. an implement used in sacrifices (described as a flat piece of wood shaped like a sword for stirring the offerings of boiled rice, or accord. to some, for trimming the mound used as an altar), AV.; TS.; Br.; GṛŚrS.; Mn.; MBh.
a spar or boom (of a ship's sails), ŚBr.
स्फ्य॑ n. a kind of oar, R.
स्फ्य [cf. accord. to some, Gk. σϕήν; Germ. spân, Span.]
स्फ्य—कृत् mfn. making a Sphya, ĀpŚr.
स्फ्य—कृत् m. N. of a man (cf. स्फैयकृत).
स्फ्य—कृत m. (prob. w.r. for prec.) g. द्वारादि.
स्फ्य—वर्तनि f. the furrow or line made by the Sphya (in marking out the sacrificial ground), AitBr.
स्फ्याग्र mfn. having a point like the Sphya (said of a sacrificial post), ŚrS.
